Entire's CLI is the source of truth for its own usage. Do not guess flags or
subcommands — read them from this command. You are already inside the repo:
entire auto-detects it from the git origin remote, so never ask the user for the
repo name. Pass --repo only to target a DIFFERENT repo.
Trails are project-scoped. Trail listing requires an explicit --project (--repo only filters within it), or --mine for your trails across projects.

Current repo: gh/llLucidll/VEGA  (auto-detected from origin; pass --repo only for a DIFFERENT repo)

  checkpoint  Inspect and search checkpoints
                read-only except: delete, explain, push
  search      Search checkpoints, commits, and sessions using semantic and keyword matching
                read-only
  session     Manage agent sessions tracked by Entire
                read-only except: adopt, attach, resume, stop
  status      Show Entire status
                read-only
  trail       Manage trails across repositories and branches
                read-only: approvals, list, sessions, show, stack, timeline, watch — others write
  why         Show why a line exists
                read-only

Also available (entire agent-help <command> for any of these):
  read-only, safe to run:
    activity · labs · recap · version
  when the task needs them:
    api · dispatch · doctor
  the user's — suggest, don't run:
    agent · auth · clean · cluster · configure · disable · enable
    login · logout · org · plugin · project · repo · service-account

Drill in for exact, currently-installed flags:  entire agent-help <command>  (e.g. entire agent-help trail)

content.text:
Yes—the eye works better than another status badge. I made **VEGA** larger, scaled the eye to match, and kept the glass pill for the three passive states:

- **Monitoring:** green, closed eye.
- **Anomaly detected:** green, open eye.
- **Council investigating:** purple eye with a pupil that glances left, pauses, then glances right. It stays still with reduced motion enabled.
- **Warden invoked:** the pill disappears. A red serpent eye and **VEGA HAS ASSUMED CONTROL** take over the view, with operator approval status still explicit.

The exact [AmazDooM font](https://www.dafont.com/amazdoom.font) is noncommercial, so I used original angular SVG lettering instead.

[Monitoring preview](/tmp/vega-idle-eye.png) · [Warden preview](/tmp/vega-warden-eye.png). All four states passed Chrome checks; lint and build passed.

import type { Point } from './topologyLayout'

const DOT_STEP = 36
const HOVER_RADIUS = 128

export function drawTopologyDots(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  origin: Point,
  zoom: number,
  hover: Point & { strength: number },
) {
  const step = DOT_STEP * zoom
  const firstX = (origin.x % step) - step
  const firstY = (origin.y % step) - step
  const base = new Path2D()
  const soft = new Path2D()
  const bright = new Path2D()
  const reacting = hover.strength > 0.01

  for (let y = firstY; y <= height + step; y += step) {
    for (let x = firstX; x <= width + step; x += step) {
      const dx = x - hover.x
      const dy = y - hover.y
      let influence = 0
      if (reacting && Math.abs(dx) < HOVER_RADIUS && Math.abs(dy) < HOVER_RADIUS) {
        influence = hover.strength * Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot(dx, dy) / HOVER_RADIUS) ** 2
      }
      // Nudge the dots away from the pointer while brightening the nearest ones.
      const px = x + dx * influence * 0.24
      const py = y + dy * influence * 0.24
      const radius = 0.85 + influence * 1.1
      const path = influence > 0.38 ? bright : influence > 0.07 ? soft : base
      path.moveTo(px + radius, py)
      path.arc(px, py, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    }

import type { Point } from './topologyLayout'

const DOT_STEP = 36
const BASE_SIZE = 1.65

export interface TopologyHover extends Point {
  strength: number
  motion: number
}

type StarPath = Pick<Path2D, 'moveTo' | 'quadraticCurveTo' | 'closePath'>

function addStar(path: StarPath, x: number, y: number, size: number) {
  const shoulder = size * 0.14
  path.moveTo(x, y - size)
  path.quadraticCurveTo(x + shoulder, y - shoulder, x + size, y)
  path.quadraticCurveTo(x + shoulder, y + shoulder, x, y + size)
  path.quadraticCurveTo(x - shoulder, y + shoulder, x - size, y)
  path.quadraticCurveTo(x - shoulder, y - shoulder, x, y - size)
  path.closePath()
}

export function drawTopologyDots(
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  width: number,
  height: number,
  origin: Point,
  zoom: number,
  hover: TopologyHover,
) {
  const step = DOT_STEP * zoom
  const firstX = (origin.x % step) - step
  const firstY = (origin.y % step) - step
  const base = new Path2D()
  const radius = 106 + 48 * hover.motion
  const reacting = hover.strength > 0.01

  for (let y = firstY; y <= height + step; y += step) {
    for (let x = firstX; x <= width + step; x += step) {
      const dx = x - hover.x
      const dy = y - hover.y
      const distance = reacting && Math.abs(dx) < radius && Math.abs(dy) < radius
        ? Math.hypot(dx, dy)
        : radius
      if (distance >= radius) {
        addStar(base, x, y, BASE_SIZE)
        continue
      }

      // Like the portfolio footer, nearby stars scale up and push radially away.
      const influence = hover.strength * (1 - distance / radius) ** 1.5
      const push = (22 + 8 * hover.motion) * influence / Math.max(14, distance)
      const size = BASE_SIZE + (4.3 + hover.motion) * influence
      const clearCenter = 1 - hover.strength * Math.max(0, 1 - distance / 18)
      const opacity = (0.15 + 0.7 * influence) * clearCenter
      // Keep distant stars low contrast; only the center of the field turns white.
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${Math.round(139 + 116 * influence)}, ${Math.round(174 + 81 * influence)}, ${Math.round(205 + 50 * influence)}, ${opacity})`
      ctx.beginPath()
      addStar(ctx, x + dx * push, y + dy * push, size)
      ctx.fill()
    }
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(139, 174, 205, 0.15)'
  ctx.fill(base)
}

import type { VegaDataSource } from './dataSource'
import { LiveStreamSource } from './liveSource'

  return useVegaStore.getState().dataMode === 'LIVE' ? liveSource : mockSource
}

export function switchDataMode(mode: 'SIMULATED' | 'LIVE', force = false) {
  const current = useVegaStore.getState().dataMode
  if (current === mode && !force) return
  activeSource().stop()
  useVegaStore.getState().setDataMode(mode)
  activeSource().start()
}

  if (useVegaStore.getState().dataMode === 'LIVE') {

  }

- Restore a full-width, semi-translucent header with a centered VEGA wordmark and a thin divider above the graph. Keep the animated, state-colored eye inside the circular VEGA-CORE hub.
- Make the topology pannable, with a sparse hover-reactive dotted background and draggable VM cards that keep their connections and do not overlap.
- Keep anomaly injection on the topology; open node details only through an explicit inspection action.
- Add canvas zoom from 50% to 100% with on-screen and keyboard controls, preserving wheel panning, node dragging, and the chosen zoom after inspection.
- Integrate a borderless telemetry readout into the header with rolling ingestion rate, retention TTL, active window, online endpoint count, captured and flagged events, and snapshot status.

Scope: frontend only. Verified with frontend lint, production build, and Chrome interaction checks in simulated mode.

[Desktop preview](/tmp/vega-dashboard-header.png) · [Mobile preview](/tmp/vega-dashboard-header-mobile.png)

Lint, build, and Chrome checks passed. Changes are local.

- Make the topology pannable, with a sparse hover-reactive dotted background and draggable VM cards that keep their connections and do not overlap.
- Keep anomaly injection on the topology; open node details only through an explicit inspection action.
- Add canvas zoom from 50% to 100% with on-screen and keyboard controls, preserving wheel panning, node dragging, and the chosen zoom after inspection.
- Display a right-to-left telemetry ticker beneath the header, with pause and reduced-motion support. It shows rolling ingestion rate, retention TTL, active window, online endpoint count, captured and flagged events, and snapshot status.

Scope: frontend only. Verified with frontend lint, production build, and Chrome interaction checks in simulated mode.
